definitions.rationale: Base equation defining the embedding of the empty proof-domain NumSeq as the empty MPY ValSeq.
definitions.text: rule numVals(.NumSeq) => .ValSeq

definitions.rationale: Recursive constructor equation defining how an integer-headed NumSeq is embedded into an MPY ValSeq.
definitions.text: rule numVals(nInt(I, NS)) => vCons(I, numVals(NS))

definitions.rationale: Recursive constructor equation defining how a float-headed NumSeq is embedded into an MPY ValSeq.
definitions.text: rule numVals(nFloat(F, NS)) => vCons(F, numVals(NS))

definitions.rationale: Base equation defining the structural length of the empty NumSeq.
definitions.text: rule numLen(.NumSeq) => 0

definitions.rationale: Recursive equation defining NumSeq length for an integer-headed sequence.
definitions.text: rule numLen(nInt(_, NS)) => 1 +Int numLen(NS)

definitions.rationale: Recursive equation defining NumSeq length for a float-headed sequence.
definitions.text: rule numLen(nFloat(_, NS)) => 1 +Int numLen(NS)

definitions.rationale: Base equation defining lastNonZero on the empty proof-domain sequence.
definitions.text: rule lastNonZero(.NumSeq) => false

definitions.rationale: Terminal constructor equation defining lastNonZero for a singleton integer sequence.
definitions.text: rule lastNonZero(nInt(I, .NumSeq)) => I =/=Int 0

definitions.rationale: Terminal constructor equation defining lastNonZero for a singleton float sequence using the model's float equality.
definitions.text: rule lastNonZero(nFloat(F, .NumSeq)) => notBool eqF(F, 0.0)

definitions.rationale: Guarded recursive equation defining lastNonZero by discarding a nonterminal integer head.
definitions.text:
rule lastNonZero(nInt(_, NS)) => lastNonZero(NS)
    requires numLen(NS) >Int 0

definitions.rationale: Guarded recursive equation defining lastNonZero by discarding a nonterminal float head.
definitions.text:
rule lastNonZero(nFloat(_, NS)) => lastNonZero(NS)
    requires numLen(NS) >Int 0

definitions.rationale: Equation defining the named validCoeffs proof-domain predicate as the conjunction of length, parity, and last-coefficient conditions.
definitions.text:
rule validCoeffs(NS)
    => numLen(NS) >=Int 2
       andBool numLen(NS) %Int 2 ==Int 0
       andBool lastNonZero(NS)

definitions.rationale: Macro expansion defining polyStep as the exact pair of translated source assignments.
definitions.text:
rule polyStep
    => Assign(
         Name("value"),
         BinOp("+", Name("value"),
                    BinOp("*", Name("coeff"), Name("power"))))
       Assign(Name("power"), BinOp("*", Name("power"), Name("x")))

definitions.rationale: Macro expansion defining polyBody as the exact translated body of the program-defined poly function.
definitions.text:
rule polyBody
    => Assign(Name("value"), Float(0.0))
       Assign(Name("power"), Float(1.0))
       Assign(Name("coeff"), Float(0.0))
       For(Name("coeff"), Name("xs"), polyStep)
       Return(Name("value"))

definitions.rationale: Macro expansion defining the named expansion-loop condition from the translated source expression.
definitions.text:
rule expandCond
    => Compare(
         BinOp("*",
           Call(Name("poly"), (Name("xs"), Name("begin"), .Exprs)),
           Call(Name("poly"), (Name("xs"), Name("end"), .Exprs))),
         CmpOp(">", Float(0.0)))

definitions.rationale: Macro expansion defining the named expansion-loop body from the translated source assignments.
definitions.text:
rule expandBody
    => Assign(Name("begin"), BinOp("*", Name("begin"), Float(2.0)))
       Assign(Name("end"), BinOp("*", Name("end"), Float(2.0)))

definitions.rationale: Macro expansion defining the named bisection-loop condition from the translated source comparison.
definitions.text:
rule bisectCond
    => Compare(
         BinOp("-", Name("end"), Name("begin")),
         CmpOp(">", Float(1e-10)))

definitions.rationale: Macro expansion defining the named bisection-loop body from the exact translated assignment and conditional.
definitions.text:
rule bisectBody
    => Assign(
         Name("center"),
         BinOp("/", BinOp("+", Name("begin"), Name("end")), Float(2.0)))
       If(
         Compare(
           BinOp("*",
             Call(Name("poly"), (Name("xs"), Name("center"), .Exprs)),
             Call(Name("poly"), (Name("xs"), Name("begin"), .Exprs))),
           CmpOp(">", Float(0.0))),
         Assign(Name("begin"), Name("center")),
         Assign(Name("end"), Name("center")))

definitions.rationale: Macro expansion defining findZeroBody as the exact translated implementation body used by the proof.
definitions.text:
rule findZeroBody
    => Assign(
         Name("begin"),
         BinOp("/",
           Call(Name("len"), (Name("xs"), .Exprs)),
           UnaryOp("-", Call(Name("len"), (Name("xs"), .Exprs)))))
       Assign(
         Name("end"),
         BinOp("/",
           Call(Name("len"), (Name("xs"), .Exprs)),
           Call(Name("len"), (Name("xs"), .Exprs))))
       Assign(Name("center"), Float(0.0))
       While(expandCond, expandBody)
       While(bisectCond, bisectBody)
       Return(Name("begin"))

definitions.rationale: Macro expansion defining solutionModule as the two translated function definitions.
definitions.text:
rule solutionModule
    => Module(
         FuncDef("poly", Params(("xs", "x")), polyBody)
         FuncDef("find_zero", Params("xs"), findZeroBody))

definitions.rationale: Base recurrence defining the polynomial accumulator summary on an empty coefficient sequence.
definitions.text: rule polyAcc(.NumSeq, _X, A, _P) => A [simplification]

definitions.rationale: Recursive equation defining one integer-coefficient step of the polynomial accumulator summary.
definitions.text:
rule polyAcc(nInt(I, NS), X, A, P)
    => polyAcc(NS, X,
               addF(A, mulF(intToF(I), P)),
               mulF(P, X))
    [simplification]

definitions.rationale: Recursive equation defining one float-coefficient step of the polynomial accumulator summary.
definitions.text:
rule polyAcc(nFloat(F, NS), X, A, P)
    => polyAcc(NS, X,
               addF(A, mulF(F, P)),
               mulF(P, X))
    [simplification]

definitions.rationale: Wrapper equation defining polyValue by the polynomial accumulator's initial accumulator and power.
definitions.text:
rule polyValue(NS, X) => polyAcc(NS, X, 0.0, 1.0)
    [simplification]

definitions.rationale: Base recurrence defining the final power summary on an empty remaining sequence.
definitions.text: rule polyPower(.NumSeq, _X, P) => P [simplification]

definitions.rationale: Recursive equation defining power advancement across an integer coefficient constructor.
definitions.text:
rule polyPower(nInt(_I, NS), X, P)
    => polyPower(NS, X, mulF(P, X))
    [simplification]

definitions.rationale: Recursive equation defining power advancement across a float coefficient constructor.
definitions.text:
rule polyPower(nFloat(_F, NS), X, P)
    => polyPower(NS, X, mulF(P, X))
    [simplification]

definitions.rationale: Base recurrence defining the final loop-coefficient summary when no coefficients remain.
definitions.text: rule polyLast(.NumSeq, C) => C [simplification]

definitions.rationale: Recursive equation defining the final loop coefficient after consuming an integer head.
definitions.text:
rule polyLast(nInt(I, NS), _C)
    => polyLast(NS, I)
    [simplification]

definitions.rationale: Recursive equation defining the final loop coefficient after consuming a float head.
definitions.text:
rule polyLast(nFloat(F, NS), _C)
    => polyLast(NS, F)
    [simplification]

definitions.rationale: Guarded recurrence defining bracketBegin after a true source expansion-loop guard.
definitions.text:
rule bracketBegin(NS, B, E)
    => bracketBegin(NS, mulF(B, 2.0), mulF(E, 2.0))
    requires gtF(mulF(polyValue(NS, B), polyValue(NS, E)), 0.0)
    [simplification]

definitions.rationale: Exit equation defining bracketBegin when the negated expansion-loop guard holds.
definitions.text:
rule bracketBegin(NS, B, E) => B
    requires notBool gtF(mulF(polyValue(NS, B), polyValue(NS, E)), 0.0)
    [simplification]

definitions.rationale: Guarded recurrence defining bracketEnd after a true source expansion-loop guard.
definitions.text:
rule bracketEnd(NS, B, E)
    => bracketEnd(NS, mulF(B, 2.0), mulF(E, 2.0))
    requires gtF(mulF(polyValue(NS, B), polyValue(NS, E)), 0.0)
    [simplification]

definitions.rationale: Exit equation defining bracketEnd when the negated expansion-loop guard holds.
definitions.text:
rule bracketEnd(NS, B, E) => E
    requires notBool gtF(mulF(polyValue(NS, B), polyValue(NS, E)), 0.0)
    [simplification]

definitions.rationale: Guarded recurrence defining the bisection summary when the loop continues and the source if-condition selects the new lower endpoint.
definitions.text:
rule bisectFrom(NS, B, E)
    => bisectFrom(NS, divF(addF(B, E), 2.0), E)
    requires gtF(subF(E, B), 1e-10)
      andBool gtF(
        mulF(polyValue(NS, divF(addF(B, E), 2.0)),
             polyValue(NS, B)),
        0.0)
    [simplification]

definitions.rationale: Guarded recurrence defining the bisection summary when the loop continues and the negated source if-condition selects the new upper endpoint.
definitions.text:
rule bisectFrom(NS, B, E)
    => bisectFrom(NS, B, divF(addF(B, E), 2.0))
    requires gtF(subF(E, B), 1e-10)
      andBool notBool gtF(
        mulF(polyValue(NS, divF(addF(B, E), 2.0)),
             polyValue(NS, B)),
        0.0)
    [simplification]

definitions.rationale: Exit equation defining the bisection summary as the lower endpoint when the loop guard is false.
definitions.text:
rule bisectFrom(_NS, B, E)
    => B
    requires notBool gtF(subF(E, B), 1e-10)
    [simplification]

definitions.rationale: Composition equation defining solveFrom by the expansion endpoint summaries followed by the bisection summary.
definitions.text:
rule solveFrom(NS, B, E)
    => bisectFrom(NS, bracketBegin(NS, B, E), bracketEnd(NS, B, E))
    [simplification]

source_rules.rationale: Trusted inversion fact asserting that an embedded NumSeq equal to the empty ValSeq must be empty; Stage 1 supplies no prior proof of this simplification in a module excluding it.
Trusted injectivity fact for numVals; every Stage 1 proof imports this simplification, so its exact statement is not separately proved before use.
Trusted integer-head inversion fact for the numVals embedding; no rule-free connection proof for this exact simplification appears in prove.sh.
Trusted float-head inversion fact for the numVals embedding; it is present in the compiled proof module before all Stage 1 kprove commands.
